notes: Dictionary example establishes wording/genre, not a specific historical incident or the original meaning author. Shrine-room bananas are dialogue content; no separate ritual custom is asserted.
Literal sense (original draft): Who is in the shrine room? Well, I have not eaten the bananas.

Interpretation (original draft): An unsolicited denial names the very act nobody had asked about, drawing suspicion to the speaker. This is an interpretation of the dialogue, not an accusation rule or a historical origin story.
